about: Beam seating modelled as a generic product: powder-coated beam on 2 T-legs with glides, seat brackets, moulded seat and back shells, vinyl seat and back pads, arm posts with pads between seats. Origin at the left end of the beam; seats 1-3 are shared, seats 4 and 5, the beam and the right leg are per type. Each type has its own geometry (parts carry 'only' for their type); shared parts have none.
